cases.purpose: A group suggestion becomes a hierarchy link

variants.label: request
variants.given: After M-08 (group suggestion), Sales raises `merge_hierarchy`: BP-900701 'Ensayo Portugal Lda.' (NIPC 509812333) subsidiary_of BP-900702 'Grupo Ensayo S.A.' (NIF A55204176) from 1 Dec 2026

expected.detail: Approved by the Sales Director; link stored with the request; the steward prepared it
BP-900701 (own tier 3) gets group tier 1 from its mother company (tier 1); reason TIER_GROUP_ROLLUP

cases.purpose: Five levels are allowed, a sixth is refused

variants.label: pass
variants.given: Chain Holding → Grupo → Ibérica → Norte → Bilbao (5 levels)

variants.label: fail
variants.given: Request to place 'Bilbao Office S.L.' under Bilbao (a sixth level)

expected.detail: Refused by the database (I12); the steward returns the request: the office is a branch address, not a subsidiary

variants.label: fail
variants.given: Request to place the Holding under Norte (Norte is already below the Holding)

expected.detail: Refused by the database (I12): it would create a loop

cases.purpose: A top parent registered outside Spain, Portugal and France

variants.label: pass
variants.given: BP-900703 'Ensayo Holding GmbH', country DE, name only, no role; Grupo Ensayo S.A. placed under it

expected.detail: Allowed as a parent with minimal data: no customer or supplier role, so the stage checks (C01) do not apply, and country-specific tax ID and postal code formats are not checked

variants.label: fail
variants.given: Someone tries to give the German holding a customer role

expected.detail: Out of scope: partners registered outside ES, PT and FR are parents only; the request is returned

cases.purpose: Reorganisation: a subsidiary is sold to another group

variants.label: event
variants.given: 'Prova UX Lda.' (BP-900611, own tier 2) leaves Grupo Prova (tier 1) and joins Grupo Norte (tier 2) on 1 Nov 2026: the old link is closed on 31 Oct, a new link opens on 1 Nov, both through approved `merge_hierarchy` requests

variants.label: as-of
variants.given: Hierarchy read as of 15 Oct 2026, and as of 27 Nov 2026

expected.detail: 15 Oct: under Grupo Prova, group tier 1. 27 Nov: under Grupo Norte, group tier 2. Reports can show either moment

cases.purpose: A subsidiary abroad with its mother company's name and no tax ID

variants.label: pass
variants.given: Support desk record 'Grupo Ensayo, Lda.' (PT, no tax ID) gets no match suggestion (M3 needs the same country)

expected.detail: Becomes its own partner, as agreed in batch M; it cannot be merged into its mother company by mistake

variants.label: request
variants.given: The steward finds it in the weekly review of new partners and raises `merge_hierarchy` to place it under Grupo Ensayo S.A.; the NIPC 510994806 is added later through a high-risk change request

expected.detail: Approved by the Sales Director; the subsidiary now rolls up to the group's tier once its own tier is known (G9)
